llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅报告临床结局，不涉及生物力学建模或增材制造，与研究方向的工程核心无关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomechanics modeling (stress shielding, micromotion), no implant design via AM, no FEA or mechanical testing.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估为日本股骨设计的弧形解剖柄在发育不良髋中的长期表现。
summary_zh.method: 回顾分析2012-2014年使用该假体的患者10年以上随访结果。
summary_zh.result: 10年假体生存率达99%，无柄周围骨折或无菌松动。
summary_zh.validation: 临床随访和放射学评估。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate long-term survivorship and complications of a curved anatomic femoral stem specifically designed for Japanese femora including dysplastic hips.
summary_en.method: Retrospective review of patients who received the stem between 2012-2014 with minimum 10-year follow-up.
summary_en.result: Ten-year implant survival was 99% with no periprosthetic fractures or aseptic loosening.
summary_en.validation: Clinical and radiographic evaluation at follow-up visits.
